errors.text: The hypothesis treats temperature as fixed near room temperature rather than predicting tribological performance across 300–1200 K.
It replaces the requested thermal degradation boundary with an unsupported contact-pressure boundary of 1.5 times yield strength.

The proposed work-hardening tribolayer and delamination mechanism does not recover the target transition from stacking-fault-mediated deformation to lattice disorder and softening above approximately 900 K.
It does not predict the observed stable hardness and wear resistance through 600 K, sharp degradation at 900 K, or increasing and strongly fluctuating friction above 900 K.
The cited bulk compression and elastic-modulus studies do not substantiate the claimed tribolayer mechanism or the numerical 1.5-times-yield-strength threshold.
